title: 第五章 蝴蝶扇了下翅膀第六章 刘备摔孩子
slug: 诸天影视从四合院开始
content_zh:
过了没有多大一会儿，保卫科的科长推门进来，只听他开口说道：
“李副厂长，秦淮茹过来领孩子了。”
“你带她过来吧，这件事必须要严肃处理，居然跑到单位院儿里点火烤鸡，是谁给他们的胆子，这全是家长纵容的结果，真要是火星把单位库房给点着了，这损失的可是公家财产，这件事的性质是很恶劣的！”
李副厂长知道秦淮茹在外面，故意在办公室里拿腔拿调，给秦淮茹施加着心理压力。
傻柱陪着秦淮茹在走廊里，离着老远就听见了李副厂长的声音，傻柱嘴角含着一丝冷笑，直接朝着李副厂长的办公室走去。
秦淮茹躲在傻柱身后，眼珠子滴溜溜乱转，她巴不得傻柱今天帮着她来出这个头。
“姓李的，少拿着鸡毛当令箭，为难个辛苦拉扯孩子的寡妇，你特么也不害臊，就咱们这厂子，有啥怕点着的？仨孩子烤个鸡吃也碍着你了？你特么缺德不缺德？”
傻柱一脸三青子的桀骜不驯，一双三角眼斜睨着李副厂长。
李副厂长气的脸都紫了，这个王八蛋仗着自己是后厨的一把手，居然连厂长都不放在眼里了，跟自己在这块儿吆五喝六的，只见李副厂长开口说道：
“何雨柱，你当你是谁？你只不过是一个食堂的厨子，厂子里的事儿什么时候轮到你来说话了？再说了，这是公家的厂子，什么事情都有个规章制度，现在正是安全防火防范月，秦淮茹没看好自己的孩子，在单位闯出了这么大的祸来，我处理她有什么毛病了？都像你这样跟我在这块儿吆五喝六的，我的工作还用不用做了？再者说了，秦淮茹跟你是什么关系？她家的事情还用得着你何雨柱来做主了？少在这块儿跟我咸吃萝卜淡操心，给我滚出去！”
换了旁人，李副厂长早就把他给开出去了，但是换了傻柱，李副厂长也头疼，不因为别的，眼瞅着年底了，各家领导的年夜饭都要靠这个厨子出马，谁让傻柱做的一手好菜呢？
傻柱冷笑了两声，看着李副厂长开口说道：
“你问我凭啥帮秦淮茹做主，不因为别的，只因为瞅着他们孤儿寡母可怜，我是她家邻居，远亲不如近邻，就这一条就够了，李副厂长，有什么章程你就划出道来，我何雨柱照单全收，秦淮茹的事儿我今天还就管定了！”
“傻柱，这可是你说的，秦淮茹家的事儿你管是不？我去公社放电影，人家送我的两只老母鸡，被秦淮茹家的棒梗给偷着宰了，然后给烤了吃了，既然你说她家的事儿你管了，那成，把我家的老母鸡赔给我吧！”
许大茂牵着自家媳妇说话间就进了保卫科，还没等李副厂长发难，他直接就对着傻柱呛了起来。
傻柱听到许大茂的声音，看着他进了办公室，脸色登时变得难看了起来，他自然知道棒梗偷着烤的鸡是许大茂家的，只是在这档口许大茂突然发难，让他感觉有些应付不过来，不过作为一个混不吝，这种事情对于他来说，只是小场面而已，只听傻柱指着许大茂的鼻子开口骂道：
“许大茂，谁特么裤裆没栓牢，把你丫的给漏出来了，你说棒梗偷你家鸡，你有证据没有？没证据你在这儿跟我胡诌八咧，你信不信我抽你丫的！”
“呦呵，可吓死我了，有人要犯浑啊，小娥，赶紧去派出所报警去，不是不承认吗？没关系，你傻柱跟我犯浑，咱有说理的地儿，我看看公安来了你这孙子再特么犯浑，屎给你打出来！”
许大茂也是气急了，这件事背后要说没有傻柱的影子，他自己现在都不信了，刚才在院儿里，让叶晨那么一分析，他是越想越来气。
娄小娥恨恨的看了眼傻柱，提脚就要出办公室，去派出所报警去，秦淮茹一看顿时急了，这件事情不管是在院儿里，还是在厂子里，最起码还是内部矛盾，真要是到了派出所，想抵赖都抵赖不了，被罚款不说，指定还得赔许大茂家的损失，到头来得不偿失，只听秦淮茹开口说道：

“小娥，你消消气，千错万错都是我这当娘的没管教好孩子，邻里邻居的，有事好说，咋还要整到派出所去呢，不至于，不至于啊！”
李副厂长知道今天敲打胁迫秦淮茹就范已经是不可能了，这工夫许大茂跑过来闹，他也乐的看个笑话，你傻柱不是能耐吗？两边儿你一起扛下吧，知道你小子肥的流油，但是那也得我给你机会，我不给你机会，你丫就是个屁，还不带响的！
傻柱看到娄小娥真的要去派出所报警也有些傻眼，要知道耍横也是分场合的，跟单位的这几头烂蒜玩儿混不吝没毛病，真要是闹到了派出所，他也麻爪，再有，何雨水的对象就在派出所里当片儿警，对于这些事儿他是再门儿清不过了，他们来调查，你想抵赖那是在做梦，到时候该怎样就是怎样，关键是犯不上啊！
许大茂冷冷一笑，看了眼傻柱，又瞟了一眼秦淮茹开口说道：
“别别别，正因为是邻里邻居的，才更不能冤枉了好人，还是让公安同志出面调查清楚的好，真要是委屈了孩子，那我不成了罪人了吗？好说不好听啊！”
“我说许大茂，你差不多得了，不就是吃了你一只鸡了吗？赔给你不就完了？集市上一只鸡也就三两块钱，人家孤儿寡母的，你丫别太过分。”
傻柱看了眼秦淮茹，开口说道。
许大茂翻了个白眼，阴阳怪气的对着傻柱开口说道：
“呵呵，傻柱，你还真是站着说话不嫌腰疼，这两只老母鸡是我下乡给人家放电影，支书特意从他家给我挑的能下蛋的老母鸡，我特意留着给小娥补身子的，你跟我说三两块钱能买一只，你在这儿跟我开什么玩笑呢？”
傻柱撇了撇嘴，开口说道：
“这玩意儿也是能补的？你家的老母鸡该不下蛋还是不下蛋。”

Not long after, the section chief of the security department opened the door and came in. He was heard to say:
"Deputy Director Li, Qin Huairu is here to pick up the child."
"Bring her here. This matter must be dealt with seriously. Who gave them the courage to actually light a fire and roast chicken in the yard of the unit? This is all the result of the parents' connivance. If Mars really sets the warehouse of the unit on fire, the loss will be public property. The nature of this matter is very bad!"
Deputy Factory Director Li knew that Qin Huairu was outside and deliberately made trouble in the office to put psychological pressure on Qin Huairu.
Silly Zhu accompanied Qin Huairu in the corridor. He heard Deputy Director Li's voice far away. With a sneer at the corner of his mouth, Silly Zhu walked directly towards Deputy Director Li's office.
Qin Huairu hid behind Shazhu, her eyes rolling around. She wished that Shazhu would help her to do this today.
"Young man named Li, don't use chicken feathers as arrows to embarrass a widow who works hard to raise a child. You are not ashamed at all. In our factory, why should we be afraid of lighting it on fire? It will bother you to roast a chicken for three children? Are you so immoral or not?"
Silly Zhu had a rebellious look on his face, and he squinted at Deputy Director Li with a pair of triangular eyes.
Deputy Factory Director Li's face turned purple with anger. This bastard, relying on his position as the head chef, actually ignored the factory director and started yelling at him. Deputy Factory Director Li said:
"He Yuzhu, who do you think you are? You are just a cook in the cafeteria. When will it be your turn to speak about things in the factory? Besides, this is a public factory. There are rules and regulations for everything. Now is the safety and fire prevention month. Qin Huairu didn't take good care of his children and made such a big splash in the workplace. What's wrong with me when I deal with her? Do I have to do my job when you're yelling at me like this? Besides, what's the relationship between Qin Huairu and you? You, He Yuzhu, don't need to worry about her here, so get out of here!"
If it had been someone else, Deputy Factory Director Li would have kicked him out a long time ago, but if it had been anyone else, Deputy Factory Director Li would have had a headache, if for no other reason than that. It was almost the end of the year, and all the leaders would have to rely on this chef for their New Year's Eve dinner. Who asked Silly Zhu to cook such good food?
Silly Zhu sneered twice, looked at Deputy Director Li and said:
"You asked me why I should make the decision for Qin Huairu, not because of anything else but because I see them as orphans and widowed mothers. I am her neighbor. Distant relatives are not as good as close neighbors. This is enough. Deputy Director Li, if you have any regulations, you can draw up the rules. I, He Yuzhu, will accept them all. I will take care of Qin Huairu's affairs today!"
"Silly Zhu, this is what you said. Do you care about Qin Huairu's family's affairs? I went to the commune to show a movie, and the two old hens they gave me were secretly slaughtered by the Qin Huairu family's stick stalks, and then roasted and eaten. Since you said that you have no control over her family's affairs, then you can compensate me for my old hens!"
Xu Damao led his wife into the security department while they were talking. Before Deputy Factory Director Li could attack, he choked on Silly Zhu.
Silly Zhu heard Xu Damao's voice and watched him enter the office. His face suddenly turned ugly. He naturally knew that the chicken Bangge secretly roasted belonged to Xu Damao's family. However, Xu Damao suddenly got angry at this stall, which made him feel a little overwhelmed. However, as a gangster, this kind of thing was just a small scene for him. Silly Zhu pointed at Xu Damao's nose and cursed:
"Xu Damao, your crotch is not fastened tightly, and your pussy is leaking out. You said that Banggeng stole your chicken, do you have any evidence? If you don't have evidence, you are telling me nonsense here, do you believe it or not, I will slap your pussy!"
"Hey, I'm scared to death. Someone is going to do something stupid. Xiao'e, go to the police station and call the police. Aren't you denying it? It doesn't matter. YouSilly Zhu is messing with me. We can be reasonable. I'll see if the police are here. If your grandson acts like a fool again, I'll beat the crap out of you! "
Xu Damao was also furious. He said that there was no shadow of Silly Zhu behind this matter. He didn't believe it now. Just now in the courtyard, when Ye Chen analyzed it like this, he became more and more angry as he thought about it.
Lou Xiao'e glanced at Silly Zhu bitterly, and was about to leave the office and go to the police station to call the police. Qin Huairu immediately became anxious when she saw it. Whether this matter was in the courtyard or in the factory, at least it was an internal conflict. If she got to the police station, she couldn't deny it even if she wanted to. Not to mention being fined, she was also designated to compensate the Xu Damao family for their losses. In the end, the gain outweighed the loss. Qin Huairu said:
"Xiao'e, please calm down. It's all my fault as a mother who failed to discipline my children. If you have something to say to your neighbors, why do you have to go to the police station? It's not like that, it's not like that! "
Deputy Director Li knew that it was impossible to coerce Qin Huairu into submission today. At this time, Xu Damao came over to make trouble. He was also happy to see a joke. Aren't you stupid Zhu capable? You can take it on both sides together. I know you are very fat, but I have to give you a chance. If I don’t give you a chance, you are just a fart, and you can’t even make a sound!
Silly Zhu was a little dumbfounded when he saw that Lou Xiao'e was really going to the police station to call the police. You must know that there are occasions for misbehavior. There is nothing wrong with hanging around with these bad guys in the work. If the trouble really goes to the police station, he will be numb. , He Yuyu’s partner is working as a police officer at the police station. He knows these things very well. They come to investigate. If you want to deny that it is a dream, then you can do whatever you want. The key is not to do it!
Xu Damao smiled coldly, glanced at Silly Zhu, then at Qin Huairu and said:
“别别别，正因为是邻里邻居的，才更不能冤枉了好人，还是让公安同志出面调查清楚的好，真要是委屈了孩子，那我不成了罪人了吗？ It’s easy to say but not nice! "
"I said Xu Damao, you're almost done, didn't I just eat a chicken of yours? Wouldn’t it be over if I compensate you? A chicken in the market only costs three or two yuan. If you are an orphan or a widower, don't go too far. "
Silly Zhu glanced at Qin Huairu and said.
Xu Damao rolled his eyes and said to Silly Zhu angrily:
"Haha, Silly Zhu, you really don't feel your back hurts when you stand and talk. These two old hens were the old hens that I went to the countryside to show movies to. The party secretary picked them for me from his house. I kept the ones specially for Xiao'e to recuperate. You told me that you can buy one for three or two yuan. What are you kidding me here? "
Silly Zhu curled his lips and said:
“This thing can also be mended? Should your old hen stop laying eggs? "
